name: DeepSeek-V2-Lite expanded MoE decoder
description: Published HF expanded-cache MLA analytical reference.

sources.text: Offline SHA256 snapshots: references/models/source-lock.json. BF16 residency includes all 64 routed experts and two shared experts in 26 MoE layers, first layer dense; untied embedding/head. Top-6 work per token; weight-read upper-bound assumes min(64,B*Q*6) distinct experts, one read per touched expert matrix, not measured routing. Greedy selection uses an explicit K-pass E-comparison proxy on a separate custom resource, not floating-point MFU. FP32 vector router and softmax; no renormalization of selected probabilities (config norm_topk_prob=false, scale=1). Dense materialized attention with useful causal pairs. Norm/softmax/SiLU vector counts are approximations; declared logical buffer reads/writes assume HBM factor=1. No inference, measured kernel claim, routing imbalance/expert parallel/network, sorting implementation, YaRN table/trig creation or allocator/runtime overhead.
Pinned HF reference execution: KV-B projection expands K/V before cache.update; stores NH*(DN+DR+DV) values/token/layer. Do not substitute the compressed MLA cache formula for this execution.
